stem: Which sentence best explains what is happening in the photograph?

options.label: A
options.text: Picking up an animal was unusual behavior for Rex, since he had not been trained to do so.

options.label: B
options.text: "The joey was snuggling up to him, jumping up to him, and Rex was sniffing and licking him—it was quite cute," Allan told a newspaper reporter.

options.label: C
options.text: A year and a half later, he was released back into the wild in an area where he could be monitored by workers at the sanctuary.

options.label: D
options.text: "His progress and release went well," Gordon commented.
